summary.en-US: Apply Vazir to website text safely, with fast global and per-site controls.
summary.fa: تغییر امن و سریع فونت متن سایت‌ها به وزیر، با کنترل کلی و تنظیم جداگانه برای هر سایت.

release_notes.en-US: Extends Vazir support into isolated Shadow DOM content and dynamically streamed app text while preserving icon fonts.
release_notes.fa: پشتیبانی از متن‌های ایزوله در Shadow DOM و محتوای پویای برنامه‌ها، همراه با محافظت از آیکن‌فونت‌ها.

version.approval_notes: This extension does not collect or transmit data and contains no remote code. A small document_start script in the page's MAIN world only announces when a web page creates a Shadow DOM root; it reads no page data and gives the isolated content script an opportunity to apply the bundled font inside that root. The bundled Vazir font is from https://github.com/Rava-milad/vazir-font and is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 included at fonts/OFL.txt. To test: install the extension, open a regular website, use the toolbar popup to toggle the font globally or for the current domain, and verify the page font changes without reloading.
